desc: Derive all preserved quantities under Operations A and B, including total zero/one counts and position-based modular invariants.
Derive an explicit necessary-and-sufficient reachability characterization for the monoid relation `0^X 1^Y = 1^Y 0^X`, using run/residual decomposition.
Investigate edge cases: `X+Y>N`, `X=Y`, `X=1` or `Y=1`, and highly uniform strings.
Design an `O(N)` algorithm to test the characterization without simulating operations.
Validate the implementation against the public sample tests.
